text:
Janelle: Quick sync  model-catalog roadmap decision: we need a small, low-risk MVP for onboarding + cutover safety. Customers keep asking for faster certs and fewer surprise regressions. Proposing 3 scope items: 1) smoke-bench on ingest, 2) explicit pin TTL + exception-token flow, 3) migration UX (estimate card + optional credits). Who's in for owners?

Raj: Smoke-bench = yes. Keep it tiny: 100 stratified queries (gen/embeds), measure p95 latency, token-cost delta, and a cheap quality proxy (BLEU-ish or overlap). Run in CI agent on upload.

Lin: Eval notes: quality proxy must be conservative. With 100 samples we get high variance; show CI and a confidence note. Also require metadata on upload: tokenizer_hash, seq_len_histogram, avg_token_len. If missing, fail fast with guidance.

Zoe: CS: customers want a short billing grace during cutover. Recommend a default 10-day credit window for migration trials and a playbook template we can trigger. Also add a console toggle "Enable migration trial (10 days credit)".

Janelle: Pin TTL idea: default 90d, but allow per-pin override. Exception-token mechanism: temporary pin-override that auto-expires. Routing must surface fallback target and why.

Raj: Routing impact: add header x-rw-pin-exception with token id for tracing; fallback chain: exception_target -> previous_pin -> compatible_variant -> error. We should log per-request fallback reason.

Lin: For canary we should mirror 0.5-1% traffic for 72h, compute quality delta and latency ratios. Decision rules (MVP): green if quality delta CI includes 0 and p95_latency < 1.4x; amber if small regression but manual review; red if >2% drop -> revert.

Zoe: Playbook: template email + rollback steps + how to request manual credit. CS wants a single-console button to trigger rollback within the credit window.

Janelle: UX: show an "Estimate" card on model page with bands: Low (<$50/mo), Medium ($50-500/mo), High (>$500/mo) for mirror cost + bench run. And a small copy: "Estimates are rough; enable trial for precise measurement."

Raj: I'll own infra hooks and the estimate endpoint. I'll prototype config and cost calc by Wed.

Lin: I'll build the smoke-bench test and the badge/CI output. Will add guidance for tokenization metadata.

Zoe: I'll draft the playbook + console copy.

ProductBot: Created ticket https://redwood.internal/prod/CAT-4021 "catalog: onboarding smoke-bench + pin-exception + migration-trial UX" assigned to Janelle, due 2024-06-01

Janelle: Decision: ship MVP with smoke-bench (100 samples), metadata validation, pin TTL + exception-token, estimate card, 10-day migration trial (manual credit), and playbook. Defer automated billing reconciliation and expanded sampling to post-MVP. Quick follow-up Fri 11am to sign-off on wording. Thanks :rocket:
